name: Synthwave / retrowave hook (E Phrygian)
key: E Phrygian (D F# A B E)
scale: E Phrygian: E F G# A B C D E
notes: E Phrygian (the 'synthwave/retrowave' minor with a flat 2nd) with a driving hook that leaps an octave and falls back. Chords: Em - F - D - Em. On FLEX use a bright analog-pads or supersaw patch, add a big delay and reverb. Pairs with house or a 16th-hat beat.
